nodes.label: D-004 Render Rings from Geometry
nodes.rationale: Ring lines 0.02-0.09 px wide at 10 m are undetectable.

nodes.label: D-005 No Ballistic Term
nodes.rationale: Sights zeroed at 10 m: drop offset 0 at 10 m, ±0.096 mm at ±0.05 m.

nodes.label: E-001 Single-frame localisation and scoring error (SIMULATED)
nodes.norm_label: e-001 single-frame localisation and scoring error (simulated)
nodes.rationale: Image term meets EST-grade in good light; dim light at 1080p wide fails

nodes.label: E-005 Theoretical localisation limit (Cramér–Rao bound)
nodes.rationale: Baseline 1.5-3.1x above bound; hypothesis not supported; first candidate is a deterministic model-based fit, not ML

nodes.label: ML gate closed
nodes.rationale: E-005 meets one half of G4; image localisation dominance unknown; deterministic fit first

nodes.label: MEA-01 Image-term impact error p95 ≤ 0.4 mm (EST-grade)
nodes.norm_label: mea-01 image-term impact error p95 ≤ 0.4 mm (est-grade)

nodes.label: D-008 No ML until baseline characterised vs CRLB
nodes.norm_label: d-008 no ml until baseline characterised vs crlb
nodes.rationale: ML must earn its place; gates G1-G5

nodes.label: R-001 ISSF 10 m air-pistol target and range rules
nodes.norm_label: r-001 issf 10 m air-pistol target and range rules
nodes.rationale: ISSF ring diameters, 10 m range, decimal scoring adopted as single source of truth in app/scoring/issf.py

nodes.label: SIGHTLINE test target SL-T1-A4
nodes.rationale: True-scale printable ISSF-style target (not official) for camera measurement; print at 100 %, measure black disc and scale bars

nodes.label: R-006 Camera stabilisation, per-frame metadata and timestamps
nodes.norm_label: r-006 camera stabilisation, per-frame metadata and timestamps
nodes.rationale: Android exposes OIS/EIS toggles and per-frame OIS samples; iOS lacks public OIS-off control, leading to Android-first platform

nodes.label: R-005 AMD FidelityFX / FSR SDK
nodes.rationale: Single-frame upscaling cannot add measurement information; FSR 4 binary only; nothing incorporated

nodes.label: R-009 Reconstruction and calibration literature
nodes.rationale: Hand tremor gives sub-pixel diversity; gyro-camera self-calibration recovers intrinsics and OIS

nodes.label: Wronski et al., Handheld Multi-Frame Super-Resolution (S-06)

nodes.label: R-013 Mission 2 research report filed
nodes.rationale: Stabilisation control findings mean E-004a/b gate everything else

nodes.label: R-014 Stabilisation experiment without laboratory equipment
nodes.norm_label: r-014 stabilisation experiment without laboratory equipment
nodes.rationale: Lever and shims produce known sub-mrad rotations; independent rigid-mounted gyroscope is dynamic ground truth

nodes.label: R-007 Trigger timing: BLE connection intervals
nodes.norm_label: r-007 trigger timing: ble connection intervals
nodes.rationale: BLE intervals >=15 ms force device-side timestamps and measured latency compensation

nodes.label: R-008 Prior art: optoelectronic shooting trainers and hold metrics
nodes.norm_label: r-008 prior art: optoelectronic shooting trainers and hold metrics
nodes.rationale: Cleanness of triggering correlated most with score, so Phase 8 metrics start from trigger-window movement

nodes.label: ML Gate Closed after Mission 2
nodes.rationale: G4 half met in simulation; E1 dominance unknown while E6/E7/E11 unmeasured; deterministic fit must be tried first; no team data.
